name: use-record-peek-row
title: useRecordPeekRow
description: The open-row contract between a list and RecordPeek — data-peek-active on the open row, scrolled into view as the peek walks.

meta.whenToUse: A hand-rolled list whose rows open in RecordPeek.
meta.whenNotToUse: DataList, DataGrid and Board, which take activeRowId and mark the row themselves.
